plans.idea: Banner read left to right: a big two-line headline with its subheadline fills the left 60%, and the Shop the Drop pill sits vertically centred in the right column as the end point of the eye's path.
Keep the original's centred stack but let the headline span almost the full width as one large line, so it fills the wide canvas, with the subheadline under it and the CTA centred below.
Editorial left-aligned stack: headline and subheadline share one strong left edge with the CTA directly beneath on the same edge, leaving open lime space on the right as deliberate breathing room.
